'''Varonat''' was a [[Planet/Legends|planet]] located in the [[Anoat sector/Legends|Anoat sector]] of the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]], situated along the [[Ison Trade Corridor/Legends|Ison Corridor]]. It was a steaming jungle and adopted home of the [[Morodin/Legends|Morodin]] [[Species/Legends|species]].<ref name="GG-Hoth" />

==History==
The Morodins colonized the planet in [[26,053 BBY]]. The descendants of these colonists ensured the survival of the species, which went extinct on their [[Morodin homeworld|original]] [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]].<ref name="FC" />

[[Human/Legends|Human]] colonists from the planet [[Salliche/Legends|Salliche]] came to Varonat in [[252 BBY/Legends|252 BBY]], founding the settlements of [[Tropis-on-Varonat]] and [[Edgefields-on-Varonat]]. These settlements never grew to more than a few thousand people, however.<ref name="GG-Hoth" />

During the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], Varonat was plagued by [[Pirate/Legends|pirates]]. A force under [[Ki-Adi-Mundi/Legends|Ki-Adi-Mundi]] and [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]] was dispatched to [[Battle of Varonat|deal]] with them in [[21 BBY/Legends|21 BBY]].<ref name="Star Wars Republic 62: No Man's Land">[[Republic 62|''Republic'' 62]]</ref>

After the [[Battle of Endor/Legends|Battle of Endor]], several [[Krish (species)/Legends|Krish]] under [[Gamgalon]] discovered that the fermented juice of Morodin-fertilized [[Aleudrupe berry/Legends|aleudrupe berries]] could be used in place of [[Tibanna/Legends|tibanna gas]] in [[Blaster/Legends|blasters]]. They covered their operation with a Morodin-hunting safari, but the [[Smuggler/Legends|smuggler]] [[Talon Karrde]], investigating the operation, wound up destroying it within a few years.<ref name="FC" />

The planet was later [[Senator of Varonat|directly represented]] in the [[New Republic Senate/Legends|New Republic Senate]].<ref name="NRI" />
